title: Olympic Dam western south process vessel
visualBrief: Whole independently placed western round process vessel at Olympic Dam. All eleven original numerical outer controls retained, complete shell/foundation/dark top surface/upper lip and estimated collars, safety rails and access ladder. Other plant bodies and the large adjacent process block remain separate. Original published Qualla NASA ISS038-E-29810 inspected first; another existing Qualla NASA JSC original ISS038-E-29809 shows the three western round bodies and their dark tops more clearly. Both exact original image bytes and native NASA mission/roll/frame public-domain releases bound. Complete round vessel morphology; actual height, top cover versus contents, materials, collars, access details, named process identity, vertical tie and exact2014-to2026 continuity remain unmeasured estimates. No photographic texture or report graphics. Nominal5m horizontal and6m vertical/component uncertainty, not survey or measured bounds. Whole original eleven-control independent round process vessel. Complete original outer shell, foundation, shallow upper lip and opaque dark top appearance surface. Top cover versus contents remains unresolved; no gabled roof, named process function or measured equipment census asserted. Other mine members remain separate; parent unfinished. Explicit initial section estimates chosen after own source field: floor0.25m, foundation bottom-1.2m, shell/lip8.25m, dark top8.05m, safety rail9.30m. Body height8m above floor, not a measured dimension. Nominal6m height/component and5m horizontal allowances are estimates, not measured error bounds. Collar bands, panel joints, safety rail and access ladder/facing are original approximate details. Original published Qualla NASA ISS038-E-29810 first, followed by existing published NASA ISS038-E-29809 for the western round-body group. Both exact original bytes and native NASA JSC ESRS mission/roll/frame public-domain releases bound. No photo texture or report graphics.
